newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent closes down, NYMEX products lead markets.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent closes down, NYMEX products lead markets.

text.p: IPE November Brent crude oil closed lower on Monday after some very choppy late trading.
Brent crude followed NYMEX WTI for the afternoon, which in turn moved with the NYMEX spot product contracts which expired at close of market on Monday, brokers said.
"It's been very choppy action. Everyone is watching NYMEX products which have fluctuated all over the shop in the last few hours," one commented.
November Brent crude oil ended the day down 27 cents at $23.20 a barrel, after trading in over a half a dollar range.

Earlier October gas oil closed up four dollars at $232.50 a tonne and was called to open Tuesday 0.50 a tonne lower after NYMEX October unleaded gasoline and heating oil hit the day's low in the last few minutes of trade.
The focus for the rest of the week would be on the U.S. distillate stock figures - the lowest late-September U.S. stocks in a generation, brokers said.

The physical Brent crude oil market took a tumble on Monday amid very limited European demand. A cargo of Brent traded at an eight cent discount to November Brent - down 14 cents a barrel from a deal on Friday.-London Newsroom +44 71 542 8978
